exposure: Anemia level (hemoglobin < 7 mg/dl, 7-9.9 mg/dl, 10-10.9 mg/dl, > 11 mg/dl)
cohort: 4800 pregnant women with iron deficiency anemia between 26(+0) and 30(+0) weeks of gestation who delivered singletons between 37(+0) and 41(+6) weeks of gestation
finding: Early third-trimester severe and moderate iron deficiency anemia were significantly associated with an increased risk of SGA and lower fetal weight.
